ailab.subtitle.en: Experiments with generative AI, building agents, and exploring the frontier of human-AI interaction.
ailab.subtitle.zh: 生成式 AI 实验、Agent 构建、人机交互的前沿探索。

ailab.gallery.desc.en: Visual experiments exploring AI-generated art, design concepts, and creative workflows.
ailab.gallery.desc.zh: 用 AI 生成艺术、设计概念和创意工作流的视觉实验。

ailab.agents.desc.en: Building AI-powered tools and autonomous agents for design, research, and productivity.
ailab.agents.desc.zh: 做 AI 驱动的工具和自主 Agent，服务于设计、研究和效率。

ailab.ideas.desc.en: Short-form observations, patterns, and questions from working with AI systems.
ailab.ideas.desc.zh: 和 AI 打交道时积累的短观察、模式和问题。

ailab.chronicle.desc.en: Each Claude Code session, rendered as an editorial receipt. An archive of AI-collaborated work — token by token, project by project.
ailab.chronicle.desc.zh: 每一次和 Claude Code 的会话，都被渲染成一张编辑风小票。一份 AI 协作作品的档案，一个 token 一个 token、一个项目一个项目地积累。

ailab.chronicle.empty.en: The archive is empty — the first chronicle will land here.
ailab.chronicle.empty.zh: 档案还是空的，第一张手札会出现在这里。

ailab.chronicle.privacy.en: Only metadata is archived — no conversation contents, no file diffs. The topic shown is the opening prompt, trimmed. Cost is a list-price estimate, not actual billing.
ailab.chronicle.privacy.zh: 手札只存元数据，不含对话内容、不含文件修改。标题是首句 prompt 的截断。显示的花费是按官方单价估算的 API 等价，非订阅实际扣费。
